verdict.rationale: First-party docs say users can review prompts, delete Gemini Apps activity, and turn off Keep Activity at any time. A separate opt-in controls whether audio, Gemini Live videos and screenshares are used to train generative AI models. Docs also state that chats and uploaded files won't be reviewed or used to improve models under certain conditions. missing for 10: explicit documentation tying the Keep Activity toggle to text-chat training exclusion, clarity on which account types the no-training guarantee covers, independent or hands-on corroboration.
